items.name: Oceania 10th Anniversary 2019

venue.name: [Wellington College](https://www.wellington-college.school.nz/facility-hire)
venue.address: 15 Dufferin St, Mount Victoria, Wellington 6021, New Zealand

items.information:
Following the first competition in Oceania (New Zealand Championships 2009), speedcubing exploded in popularity across the continent. Now, ten years later, we're holding a competition to celebrate the growth of the community, and everything we've achieved over that period. Oceania 10th Anniversary 2019 returns to Wellington, the site of that first competition, and marks almost exactly ten years since then.
Additionally, this is the first competition of the "Cubing Down Under Tour" - a tightly scheduled series of competitions across Oceania, leading up to WCA World Championship 2019, in Melbourne. This should build hype for the World Championship, and, (especially for foreign competitors) provide an excellent opportunity to experience more of the continent. For more information, visit the [travel page](https://wc2019.speedcubing.org.au/en/travel) of the World Championship website.

Welcome to the 5th edition of the Swedish Decathlon Challenge! The competition will follow the same structure as during the last decathlons with competitors collecting points during the ten events. More information about the Swedish Decathlon as well as more information about the competition, payment and registration can be found under the tabs above. Remember that the competition will be run just as any other WCA competition where everyone are welcome to visit and participate. The decathlon challenge is considered to be unofficial.

-----

Välkommen till den 5:e upplagan av Swedish Decatlon Challenge! Tävlingen följer samma struktur som under de senaste tävlingarna där tävlande samlar poäng under de tio grenarna. Deltagaren med flest poäng efter tävlingens slut blir tiokampsmästare 2019. Deltagargränsen för denna tävling är satt till 80. Mer information om tävlingen, betalning och registrering finns under flikarna ovan. items.name: Copa Black Horse 2019

venue.name: Policlinico de Salud San Juan
venue.address: Av Pedro Miotta & Av Ramon Vargas Machuca, San Juan de Miraflores

items.information:
**ESPAÑOL**
Este es el primer torneo patrocinado por y realizado con la ayuda de Black Horse Toys. Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el reglamento de la WCA.

REGISTRO:

El registro se considera completo cuando se ha completado el registro electrónico y se ha realizado el pago (precio y métodos de pago explicados en la sección de requisitos de registro).

Cada competidor debe elegir los eventos en los que se va a inscribir cuidadosamente luego de revisar la pestaña “Horario" (Schedule). Prestar atención a los formatos de cada ronda y a sus respectivos cortes y límites detallados en la pestaña “Categorías” (Events).

Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID.

*Los competidores que vengan de fuera de Lima deberán comunicarse y coordinar la forma de pago directamente con el organizador

El registro permanecerá abierto hasta el viernes 31 de mayo o hasta que se alcance el límite de competidores.

**ENGLISH**
This is the first competition sponsored by Black Horse Toys store. The results of this competition will be listed on the WCA world rankings and new competitors will get an official WCA profile. For that reason, each competitor must be familiar with and understand the WCA Regulations before the competition.

REGISTRATION:

A register is considered complete when electronic registration has been completed and payment has been made (registration fees and payment methods are detailed at Registration requirements section).

Each competitor must carefully choose the events in which he/she will participate after having seen the Schedule tab. Please pay attention to the formats of each round and its respective time limits and cutoffs detailed at the Events tab.

It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID.

*Competitors who come from outside Lima will have to contact the organizer in order to coordinate the payment method.

Registration will stay opened till May 31 or till competitor limit is reached.
